_about: PARKED DRAFT. 40 titles for the fighter-select card and the beats' cut-ins (Game Design's reward economy, docs/design/run-mode.md section 4.4 and unlocks.md). 24 style-label titles (4 fighters x 6 labels), 4 mastery-60 nameplates, 10 run-style titles (conditions proposed; Game Design confirms), and 2 account titles. Names only; no title is earned by a death. Claude-written; not marked by Orb.
